# Layout Checklist: Mantle as a mod of its own

**Purpose**: Test the quality of R14's requirements before tasks are written: whether each names its source, and
whether the repository layout, Mantle's metadata and the move of Imperium's files are complete, clear, consistent and
measurable. A standard gate, for the author and the pull request's reviewer.
**Created**: 2026-11-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and
requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only
when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not
mean implementation work is complete.

## Source Traceability

- [ ] CHK001 Does every functional requirement, success criterion and edge case name a source from the constitution's
  Source Register, and is each conclusion reached from that source rather than only labelled with it? [Traceability,
  Spec §Sources, FR-001 to FR-016]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the decision to keep Mantle in this repository reached from the repository's source (GitHub Docs) and
  the workflow's (Spec Kit), with the design used only for what Mantle is, and not from the Harmony mod's own
  repository? [Traceability, Spec §FR-012, Clarifications; Plan R-1]
- [ ] CHK003 Where R14 gives Mantle the form R1 gave Imperium, is each such requirement backed by the sources R1 used
  rather than by R1 alone? [Traceability, Spec §FR-005, FR-011; Plan R-4 to R-8]

## Repository Layout

- [ ] CHK004 Is "named after its mod" specific enough to give each folder's name without interpretation? [Clarity,
  Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the line between a mod's own files and the files that serve the repository or both mods drawn for
  every file at the repository root today? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Clarifications; Data-model §Repository layout]
- [ ] CHK006 Is it specified which README each of the three places holds (each mod folder, the root) and what each
  says? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, FR-014; Plan R-3]
- [ ] CHK007 Are FR-014 (the license stays at the root) and FR-015 (each mod folder holds the license) worded so that
  they do not read as a conflict? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, FR-015]
- [ ] CHK008 Is what moves out of the root, and that it moves unchanged, explicit enough that FR-016 can be verified?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-016; Data-model §Repository layout]

## Mantle's Metadata

- [ ] CHK009 Are the requirements on the package identifier complete: format, uniqueness, difference from Imperium's,
  and permanence once released? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "requires no expansion or any other mod" consistent with the later Harmony requirement the
  assumptions describe? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the reason Mantle loads after every official expansion sourced, given that R14 itself adds no
  content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Is Mantle's place relative to Imperium specified both for this feature and for R13? [Coverage, Spec §Edge
  Cases, FR-011]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Is each success criterion's baseline unambiguous, including the combination with no expansion?
  [Clarity, Spec §SC-001, SC-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Does SC-006 state measurably which files a mod folder may hold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, FR-014]
- [ ] CHK015 Do the success criteria cover FR-012 and FR-013, one repository with two mod folders side by side?
  [Coverage, Spec §SC-006, FR-012, FR-013]

## Edge Cases and Dependencies

- [ ] CHK016 Is the edge case of a whole-repository copy in the game's mods tied to what the developer's test setup
  must do instead? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases; Plan R-9]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the merged R13 documents that assume Mantle's own repository and Imperium's files at the root named
  as depending on this feature's layout? [Dependency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the edge case of Royalty active with Mantle consistent with ROADMAP R2, which removes the base game's
  Empire? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases; Roadmap R2]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the claim that a second repository would be a second Spec Kit project with its own constitution
  sourced to Spec Kit? [Assumption, Plan R-1]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- The commit that adds this checklist also changes the spec for CHK007 (FR-014 now says the root keeps its own README
  and license file while each mod folder holds its own README and a copy of the license), CHK014 and CHK015 (SC-006
  now names FR-014's files and the two folders side by side) and CHK017 (Assumptions now name the R13 documents that
  follow this layout); the reviewer judges whether each is now satisfied
